facts.name: all twelve FK groups: four numeric function/index/endpoint links
facts.sql: WITH targets AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['public.mixer_browser_sessions'::regclass,'public.mixer_browser_session_vault'::regclass,'public.mixer_browser_oidc_attempts'::regclass,'public.mixer_browser_session_events'::regclass,'public.mixer_authz_profiles'::regclass,'public.mixer_authz_principals'::regclass,'public.mixer_authz_bindings'::regclass,'public.mixer_authz_families'::regclass,'public.mixer_authz_credentials'::regclass]) AS oid) SELECT count(*)=12 AND bool_and((SELECT count(*)=4 AND bool_and(t.tgconstrindid=k.conindid AND NOT t.tgdeferrable AND NOT t.tginitdeferred AND t.tgenabled='O' AND t.tgisinternal AND ((t.tgfoid='pg_catalog."RI_FKey_check_ins"()'::regprocedure AND t.tgtype=5 AND t.tgrelid=k.conrelid AND t.tgconstrrelid=k.confrelid) OR (t.tgfoid='pg_catalog."RI_FKey_check_upd"()'::regprocedure AND t.tgtype=17 AND t.tgrelid=k.conrelid AND t.tgconstrrelid=k.confrelid) OR (t.tgfoid='pg_catalog."RI_FKey_noaction_del"()'::regprocedure AND t.tgtype=9 AND t.tgrelid=k.confrelid AND t.tgconstrrelid=k.conrelid) OR (t.tgfoid='pg_catalog."RI_FKey_noaction_upd"()'::regprocedure AND t.tgtype=17 AND t.tgrelid=k.confrelid AND t.tgconstrrelid=k.conrelid))) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgconstraint=k.oid)) FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.contype='f' AND(k.conrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM targets) OR k.confrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM targets))

facts.name: exact external referencing set
facts.sql: WITH targets AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['public.mixer_browser_sessions'::regclass,'public.mixer_browser_session_vault'::regclass,'public.mixer_browser_oidc_attempts'::regclass,'public.mixer_browser_session_events'::regclass,'public.mixer_authz_profiles'::regclass,'public.mixer_authz_principals'::regclass,'public.mixer_authz_bindings'::regclass,'public.mixer_authz_families'::regclass,'public.mixer_authz_credentials'::regclass]) AS oid) SELECT array_agg(conrelid::regclass::text ORDER BY conrelid::regclass::text)=ARRAY['mixer_authz_memberships','mixer_customer_idempotency'] FROM pg_constraint WHERE contype='f' AND confrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM targets) AND conrelid NOT IN(SELECT oid FROM targets)

facts.name: incoming RI wrong constraint group
facts.sql: SELECT count(*)=2 FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_constraint k ON k.oid=t.tgconstraint WHERE k.conrelid='public.mixer_authz_memberships'::regclass AND k.confrelid='public.mixer_authz_principals'::regclass AND t.tgtype=5

facts.name: foreign-key child equality vector empty
facts.sql: SELECT count(*)=2 AND bool_and(cardinality(conffeqop)=0) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.mixer_browser_sessions'::regclass AND contype='f'

facts.sql: SELECT i.indcollation[0]<>a.attcollation AND i.indcollation[1]=0 FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=i.indrelid AND a.attname='id' WHERE i.indexrelid='public.mixer_authz_profiles_pkey'::regclass

facts.sql: SELECT attacl IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(attacl)=0 FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.mixer_browser_sessions'::regclass AND attname='id'

facts.name: inconsistent fast default hasmissing with NULL value

facts.name: identity metadata has no default equivalence

facts.name: owner raw ACL grant option denied despite implicit rights
